match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: The passing cyclist steadies the coffee, and Scarlett wipes the tiny coral mark from the cup rim with her thumb. Framing: close-up, eye level, The coffee cup and gloved hand dominate the foreground, with Scarlett’s amused face and phone visible behind them in shallow focus. Placement only, not the pose: The cyclist is braking beside Scarlett with one gloved hand reaching toward her tilting coffee cup, while Scarlett looks startled and keeps filming. Camera, as one or two arrows: push-in, gradual. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. Passing cyclist, Unspecified, 20s-40s, An athletic adult cyclist with a lean build, Fitted cycling jacket, dark athletic trousers, helmet, practical. Mina, Woman, Late 20s, A woman in her late 20s, Green utility jacket with a roomy pocket, simple. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels.
